intelligence.essence: Mastery means giving the user the ultimate app: logical, sensible, beautiful, alive, push-button simple, everything intentional. Humans are visual and they skim — titles, subtitles, the shape of the page — so the system must speak visually and make itself understood in seconds. The magic of the Intelligent Blocks is the whole method in miniature: a whole book distilled into one block that says, in plain words, what it was about, the lesson in it, what it ultimately means, why it matters, how it connects, and what is in it for the reader — taken in, in about a minute, instead of hours or days. Apply that same distillation to the whole system, and people learn faster, grow faster, and their world gets organized and automated highly effectively. That is active intelligence: elevated, sensible, organized. That is 10-star service.
